intro: From plush comfort to lasting support, our Aqmatic mattress balances softness with strength. It eases pressure points,helping your body unwind fully so you wake up rested, recharged, and ready for the day.

features.title: Spring core that cradles you in comfort
features.text: Bounce back to comfort! Durable felt sheets hold springs in place, ensuring lasting support and responsive comfort for restful sleep.

features.title: Enjoy pressure-free comfort every night
features.text: Sleep deeper and wake up revitalised—this mattress evenly distributes weight, reducing pressure points for unmatched relaxation and comfort.

features.title: Soft quilted top for added relaxation
features.text: Enjoy a plush, breathable surface that feels soft to the touch, transforming every night into a luxurious sleeping experience.

features.title: Support that conforms for peaceful sleep
features.text: Every inch of our soft foam layer works with your body, adapting to your shape and movement, ensuring plush, uninterrupted comfort all night long.

features.title: Stylish side trim made of upholstery fabric
features.text: The side trim crafted with premium upholstery fabric adds a touch of elegance and durability. This design detail enhances the mattress’s aesthetic appeal while ensuring lasting strength and a refined finish.

features.title: Sized just right for your bed frame
features.text: Tailored to your bed’s unique size, our custom dimensions give you a flawless fit that feels like it was made just for you.

name: Aqmatic Bonnell Single Bed Spring Mattress 78 X 30 X 6 Inches
